abstract: It is widely believed that abnormal proliferation of tumor cells is due, at least in part, to the production of autocrine growth factors that are not produced by their normal counterparts. However, direct support for this belief is seriously lacking. The normal counterparts of the vast majority of tumor cells have not been identified adequately and, thus, the growth factors produced by the normal counterparts of tumor cells have not been described. This review summarizes the remarkable similarity in the types of growth factors and growth factor receptors produced by early mouse embryos and by mouse embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of teratocarcinomas. Based on these similarities and the likelihood that embryonal carcinoma cells are derived from the totipotent cells of the mammalian embryo, it is argued that there is reason to suspect that ectopic production of growth factors is not a major cause of tumor induction and tumor growth. It is further proposed that differentiation under normal conditions can limit autonomous cell proliferation by shifting cells from a population that produces growth stimulatory factors to cell types that produce growth inhibitory factors instead. Consequently, blocks in differentiation may lead to tumor growth by maintaining the production of growth stimulatory autocrine factors.
abstract_ja: 腫瘍細胞の異常な増殖は、少なくとも部分的には、正常の対応細胞では産生されない自己分泌増殖因子の産生によるものだと広く信じられている。しかし、この信念を直接支持する証拠は乏しい。大多数の腫瘍細胞の正常対応細胞は十分に同定されておらず、したがって腫瘍細胞の正常対応細胞が産生する増殖因子も記載されていない。本総説では、初期マウス胚と、奇形癌の幹細胞であるマウス胎児性癌細胞とが産生する増殖因子および増殖因子受容体の種類が驚くほど類似している点をまとめる。これらの類似点と、胎児性癌細胞が哺乳類胚の全能性細胞に由来するという可能性に基づき、増殖因子の異所性産生が腫瘍誘導や腫瘍増殖の主要な原因ではないと疑う理由があると論じる。さらに、正常条件下での分化は、増殖刺激因子を産生する細胞集団から増殖抑制因子を産生する細胞型へと細胞を移行させることで、自律的な細胞増殖を制限しうると提案する。したがって、分化の阻害は増殖刺激性の自己分泌因子の産生を維持することで腫瘍増殖を招く可能性がある。
